title: Skiing bumps
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: Look ahead and choose your line.
Bend your legs to absorb each bump, then stretch into the trough.
Keep your upper body calm and facing downhill.

callouts.text: Uneven humps: every bump is different, so every turn is.
Tilt stays modest: quick turns with a lot of absorbing.
Note: the skier bends and stretches with the bumps, which boot tilt alone doesn't show.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
